For our guests

Good to Know

Getting around

The Sangeet is at Bavlu, outside the city, so allow extra time on the road. Everything else is in west Ahmedabad. Each event has a map link.

The weather

Late November days in Ahmedabad are warm and the evenings turn pleasantly cool.

Evenings outdoors

The Sangeet, wedding and reception are evening events. A light shawl or jacket is handy.

Flying in

The nearest airport is Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International (AMD). Ahmedabad Junction is the main railway station.
